items.text: The new hotfix for Fernbus Simulator on PC is now available! As announced in our preview, it addresses numerous issues in the England DLC, improves AI traffic and fixes various bus functions. The hotfix also includes further corrections to the game world, controls and graphics.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26064558/ecca31af4e2226ddcd14d0a01cf6011b2f024398.png"]

notes.title: Fixes for England and AI traffic

items.text: We have corrected lane configurations in England that were confusing AI traffic in some locations. AI vehicles now also check further behind them before changing lanes.

The traffic mix has been adjusted as well: London-specific AI vehicles have been added, while the number of police cars in England has been reduced. Police vehicles from other countries should also no longer appear in the wrong locations.

Further fixes address AI driver seating positions, incorrect licence plates and the indicators on some AI vehicles. We have also resolved an issue where the player’s bus could prevent AI buses from spawning, along with a crash when driving into Oxford.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26064558/6e29727a389fea7d6ce8980c60ba1d969744c2a7.png"]

For buses, one focus has been cameras and lighting. We have fixed the door action cameras and camera brightness in the Tourism W410, as well as passenger lighting in several buses. The driver lights in the Neoplan Skyliner and Scania Interlink have also been corrected.

Other changes affect ventilation animations and controls: ComfortClass buttons no longer activate twice, and the game now pauses correctly when refuelling. In Arcade mode, we have fixed issues with the engine not turning off when leaving the vehicle and the luggage door not opening at the start.
Ferry crossings and train journeys now count as breaks when evaluating your trip. A message also appears when FlixBus announcements cannot play due to the selected game mode.

Alongside these changes, we have addressed issues with Photo Mode, fog and signs. Missing repaints and sound options are available again. We have also fixed FSR issues, updated DLSS and resolved crashes when switching routes or starting the game with Multi-Display.
Thank you for your bug reports and feedback! You can find the full changelog below.

Hello everyone,
Update 35 for Fernbus Simulator is now available!
The highlight of this update is the upgrade to Unreal Engine 5.6, bringing Fernbus Simulator to a more up-to-date technical foundation. As part of the upgrade, FSR and DLSS have also been updated.

The update also introduces a new sky and weather system. Vehicle friction is now affected by the surface and current weather conditions. Traction control as well as the ABS and ASR systems for buses have also been updated. Further improvements include gamepad controls, Photo Mode, mirrors and the interaction between wheels and curbs.
Fernbus Simulator also receives the new city of Bremerhaven, including a bus stop, which is added free of charge for all players with Update 35.
The England DLC and the Tourism W410 have also been released for Fernbus Simulator alongside Update 35. Both DLCs are available separately or together as a bundle.

For Update 21 we have optimized a lot to get better performance. We hope that your PC systems will also benefit from this new update. In addition, we redesigned the physics of driving and vehicle sound systems to enhance the feeling of driving a large vehicle and make it more believable. Both of these changes, optimization and physics of driving, have been implemented based on your requests. Thus, we are looking forward to your feedback.
Please note that you can adjust the tilt of the vehicles in the options menu, see screenshot.

Nevertheless, we advise you to be careful at first to get used to the new behaviour of vehicle physics. Professional bus drivers in real life make it seem easy to drive buses, but the control of these large vehicles also requires a lot of skill, sensitivity and anticipatory driving around curves, serpentines and bottlenecks without any problems in our simulator too.

Unfortunately, we had to deactivate the DirectX 12 mode, because DX12 is causing crashes with the current version of Unreal Engine 4.22. As far as we know, Epic Games is working to implement DirectX 12 enhancements to Unreal Engine 4.23 for DirectX 11. Also, update 21 will not remain the only Fernbus Simulator update, which will improve the optimization.
Detailed information can be found in the Changelog below.
By testing this update and sending us your feedback you can make sure this update will be released smoothly and eventually with additional fixes too.

In your Library, you click with the right mouse button on the entry of the "Fernbus Simulator"
In the drop-menu, you click on the entry "Properties"
In the window "Fernbus Simulator - Properties" you select the tab "BETAS"
In the field "Select the beta you would like to opt into:" select the entry "beta-"
Now you can close the window and the beta version of the update should download right away
After downloading the update you can start the Tourist Bus Simulator via the "PLAY" button
In the main menu should now be the corresponding version number of the beta version of the update and you can test the update

notes.title: How to activate or adjust your Force Feedback

items.text: Force Feedback should automatically be activated. If not, you can find it in the Options Menu under Game Options on the very bottom of the list.

notes.title: You can increase or decrease the following values

items.text: Spring Force - force of recentering while driving
Damper Force - Dampening of the swivel resistance
Road Effect Force - damages on the road and effect of the engine
Collision Effect Force - for the intensity of impacts

notes.title: How to change the seat position and driver camera

items.text: You can change the seating position and driver camera by pressing the Tab or Tabulator key on your keyboard.
On the bottom left, you should notice a new button with an icon, which obviously looks like a driver seat with and an eye.
Left click on the button and the menu for configuring your seating position and driver camera will appear.
You can find the keys for the Radio in the Control Settings in the General category.
Radio Hotkeys
Volume Up - Num-
Volume Down - Num+
Switch Radio Channel - Num*

We have intensively worked on the performance of the game and improved it in many situations. Starting with loading times, over lighting and shadow rendering, to overall improvements in frame rates. The SkyDome and lighting systems have been improved with the help of your feedback. Thanks to all for the amazing help! Adding to that, many cities have been updated and partially expanded. The update also includes the brand new city of Stralsund. We've put a lot of effort in proving the AI traffic and adding new features to it. The physics and sound systems of all coaches have been improved as well for a more authentic and realistic experience.
There have been a lot of minor and major additional improvements and fixes, which you can read through in detail in the patch notes.
We hope you will enjoy this update and an overall improved Fernbus Coach Simulator Reloaded!
